My sister recently gave me a large bag of frozen strawberry's and so I figured to put them to good use and started making smoothies. They've just been the most perfect drink especially on these hot summer days (95* today). I've read to add sugar but I've really been digging the natural sweetening from the fruits and touch of creamer by it self.
